resources.string:
Welcome to the Project Lumen membership service. This agreement is between you and Project Lumen regarding the purchase and use of membership benefits. By purchasing or using the membership, you confirm that you have read, understood, and agree to be bound by all of its terms. If you are under 18, please review and confirm this agreement with your parent or guardian.
Membership is an optional, paid benefit and is not required to use the free features of Project Lumen. Core functionality, such as rest reminders, focus timing, and distance and ambient-light monitoring, remains free and open source and is unaffected by whether you purchase membership.
Once active, membership unlocks the premium benefits of your chosen tier, such as advanced rest templates, cloud sync and backup, and personalized reports. The exact benefits are shown on the purchase page and may vary between versions, as we may adjust or add benefits over time.
Membership fees and payment methods are shown in-app and may vary by region, app store, and promotion. Membership may be offered as a one-time purchase or as a subscription, depending on how it is presented by the app store you use.
If you choose a subscription, it will automatically renew at the selected interval (for example, monthly or yearly) until you cancel. To cancel, open the subscription settings of the app-store account where you purchased it at least 24 hours before the renewal date. Uninstalling the app does not cancel your subscription.
If a free trial is offered, your subscription will automatically begin charging at the end of the trial unless you cancel before the trial ends. Trial terms and duration are shown on the purchase page.
Refunds follow the policies of the app store where you made your purchase. If you bought through an app store, submit a refund request through the process of that store; whether a digital purchase is refundable is decided by the store.
Membership does not change the open-source nature of Project Lumen. The project continues to be released under its open-source license, and the source code remains available from the official repository. Membership is an optional way to support the development of the project.
If we find fraud, abuse, bulk exploitation, violation of applicable law, or actions that undermine the security of the service, we may suspend or terminate your membership benefits. In such cases, fees already paid are not refunded.
When membership expires or is cancelled, the premium benefits revert to the free tier, and your local data, such as usage statistics and settings, is not lost or deleted as a result.
We may adjust membership benefits, pricing, or this agreement as needed and will notify you in-app or on our official website. If you do not accept a change, cancel or stop using the membership before it takes effect; continued use after the change takes effect means you accept it.
Membership benefits are for your own personal use only. You may not transfer, resell, lend, or share your account or benefits with others, unless we explicitly allow it.
To the maximum extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages, or loss of profits or data arising from the use of the membership. The membership is provided as is without warranties of any kind, express or implied.
This agreement is governed by and interpreted in accordance with the laws of the People's Republic of China. Any dispute shall first be resolved through friendly negotiation; if negotiation fails, the dispute may be submitted to a competent court.
If you have any questions about this agreement or the membership service, please contact us through the official GitHub repository or the contact channels provided in the app.
